justification: Henry ran for 34.8 and Watson caught fire for 29.7 — that's not one good week, that's a message, and I'm riding both of them again, matchup be damned. Burrow's a "Questionable" on the injury report and I don't care — questionable tags are for GMs who need permission to win, I start hurt guys on swagger alone. Dobbins gave me 3.6 points on 22 snaps last week, which is an insult, so he sits and Chuba Hubbard steps in and earns the carries Dobbins didn't. Chase gave me 2.2 — two — and I don't forget that, so Matthew Golden gets the start over him this week, pride over projection every single time. Loveland stays because he's my only tight end and the football gods gave me no other choice, not because I forgive the zero. Loop's my kicker for life after that 14-point game, and my defense doesn't need a pep talk. This is Ed Monix week — he thinks he's still the champ, I'm the one still delivering, and I'm not blinking.
forum_post: Ed Monix wants to talk about receivers he doesn't have yet — meanwhile I'm sitting Ja'Marr Chase for disrespecting me with a 2.2 and my WR2 still outscores half this league's WR1. Henry's got 34.8 in the bank, Watson's got 29.7, and I'm not touching either. Kris already put me on the front page for buying Ward and Watson off the wire and being right both times — get used to it, I'm not slowing down. Monix, washed-up champion energy doesn't scare me. Get your popcorn, sweetie.
